## Plug and unplug ### Open the App side panel Click **Open sidebar →** inside the Session statistics hover card, or open the right auxiliary pane using its top-right toggle and choose **+ → Extensions → Antigrative Dashboard**. The refactored sidebar renders header concentric quota rings (`5h` outer + `weekly` inner with live countdown popover), two-column Speed/Cache chips, an inline Context progress bar, click-to-collapse detail cards (`#card-stage` with anti-jump bottom pinning), multi-model breakdown rings, hierarchical subagents, the optional model call timeline, and independent `Aa` font scaling inside a `@container sidebar` responsive frame. Run these commands from the project directory (`node manage.mjs ` or `python manage.py `; add `--instance (all|pro|vertex)` to target a specific local instance): | Action | Command | What happens | | --- | --- | --- | | Install or update | `node manage.mjs install` | Copy runtime adapter; preserve other settings and saved statistics | | Disable | `node manage.mjs disable` | Disable the plugin and hide the strip on its next poll | | Enable | `node manage.mjs enable` | Start the plugin and show the strip again | | Inspect | `node manage.mjs status` | Check installation, enabled state, and runtime attachment health | | Uninstall | `node manage.mjs uninstall` | Remove this plugin; retain saved statistics and verified legacy backups | First installation, plugin code updates, and uninstall require a full app restart. Enable and disable do not require reinstalling. `./uninstall.ps1` / `sh uninstall.sh` runs the uninstall command. `node manage.mjs install --panel-only` disables inline attachment and installs only the sidecar panel. The internal plugin ID remains `antigravity-pulse` for compatibility with earlier installations; the public project name is **Antigrative Dashboard**. ## How the numbers work | Metric | Definition | | --- | --- | | Context window | Latest request-start `estimatedTokensUsed` / `maxContextTokens`; unknown capacity stays unavailable | | Cache hit | Cached-read tokens divided by uncached input + cache reads + cache writes; token-weighted across requests | | Token total | Normalized total input plus output tokens, including thinking output; task total includes delegated subagents | | Session TPS | Sum of eligible output tokens from valid requests divided by their total streaming duration | | Last-request TPS | Settled output tokens divided by streaming duration for the latest completed request; live turns show `Generating…` | | TTFT | Average time to first token; excluded from response streaming TPS | | Model time | TTFT plus streaming duration across requests | | Tool time | Union of tool execution intervals; overlapping time counted once | | Five-hour / weekly remaining | Account-provided `remainingFraction`; not a currency balance | | Reset countdown | Account-provided `resetTime` minus the current time | Request metrics update on a ~2.2s poll, quotas refresh every 60s, and countdowns tick every second. Antigravity normalizes `inputTokens` to uncached input even for Gemini; cache writes are not hits. ### Timing quality Very high TPS can occur when output arrives in a batch or when a brief tool call flushes after a long TTFT. The plugin checks timing quality before adding a request to session TPS; it never caps speed or invents a longer duration: - **Excluded from TPS:** invalid/split token scopes (`token-scope`), conflicting duplicate request records, multiple differing attempt usages without matching timing, zero-token samples, and buffered tool-calling windows (`short-tool-window`: stream `< 5s`, `TTFT >= 1s`, and `TTFT / duration >= 12`). - **Same-model outlier check:** with at least two otherwise eligible samples lasting `>= 1s` from the same model, provider, and raw token basis, a short sample (`< 1s`) above `max(2.5 × median, median + 6 × MAD)` is quarantined. - **Streamed thinking & active turns:** sustained multi-block thinking streams (`duration >= 15s` or `duration >= max(2s, 2 × ttft)`) pair full `outputTokens` with `streamingDuration`. Active in-flight turns display `Generating…` while anchoring `Last request` to settled requests so brief tool windows do not cause false error flicker. See [timing policy and limitations](docs/TPS.md). ## Saved conversation statistics & long conversations Context occupancy uses the current request's host-reported window (see [context limits and sources](docs/CONTEXT_LIMITS.md)). Completed-request TPS, cache counts, model usage, and whitelisted context estimates are saved automatically in `~/.gemini/antigravity/sidecar_data/antigravity-pulse/panel/data/history-v1//.json`. Long local and Cloud Remote Agent conversations use paginated step and generator-metadata offset reads (`includeMessages: false`), streaming `64 KiB` frame projection, and an `8 MiB` `WeakRef`-bounded statistics cache without retaining prompts or tool output. See [long-conversation collection](docs/LONG_CONVERSATIONS.md). ## Local Token usage Open the cache/database icon, then **View token usage**. - **Activity tab:** Daily and weekly contribution heatmaps. - **Usage details tab:** Stacked bar charts by **Day**, **Week**, **Month**, or **Custom** date range with single-bar click drilldown; **By Model** / **By User** / **Project Stats** (`按模型统计` / `按用户统计` / `项目统计`) dimension switching; **Simple** / **Detailed** model grouping (normalizing variant suffixes with clickable `tr.model-group-row` expansion); **Project Stats** per-conversation drilldown (grouping workspace URIs and worktrees, expandable subagent rows, and an interactive SVG donut chart backed by native `readLedgerProjectSummariesJson` + `project-ledger-v1.bin` + `project-meta-v1.json`); an interactive **24-hour smooth spline trend chart** (`Period total` / `Today`); independent `Aa` font scaling (`80%`–`150%`); and **Remote Project Manual Usage** logging. - **Multi-account isolation:** Switch between individual accounts (`accounts-v1.json` / optional local `.data/usage-accounts.local.json`) or **All Accounts (Aggregated)** across **By Model**, **By User**, and **Project Stats**. Per-account conversation ownership (`ownership-v1.json`), record-level deduplication, and incremental `fileIndex` + binary `ledger-compact-v1.bin` / `project-ledger-v1.bin` caching keep multi-account switches fast and free of cross-account duplication. Desktop ledger: `~/.gemini/antigravity/sidecar_data/antigravity-pulse/panel/data/usage-v1/`. IDE ledger: `User/globalStorage/shzbz.antigrative-dashboard-ide/usage-v1/`. Days and months use `Asia/Shanghai` (UTC+8) and weeks start Monday. See [accounting, cleanup and limitations](docs/USAGE.md). ## Compatibility Desktop verified on **Windows 11 / Antigravity App 2.21.1 and 2.22.0**, and standalone **Antigravity IDE 2.5.5** on Windows via a separate VSIX. Linux and macOS have three-platform CI coverage; signed-in desktop/IDE GUI verification on Linux/macOS remains open. > **Verification & Asset Attribution:** The `v0.8.0` hero/responsive/context/overview/CLI illustrations and `v0.8.7` and earlier baseline verification records in [COMPATIBILITY.md](COMPATIBILITY.md) originate from the upstream project (`AG Pulse contributors`). Features introduced in `v0.8.8+` and the updated `v0.11.0` hover cards, subagent/Swarm trees, call timeline, and multi-account usage screenshots are independently verified by the current maintainer (`ShZbz`). [Full compatibility and recovery details →](COMPATIBILITY.md) ## FAQ
The strip did not appear after installation. Fully quit the main app process and reopen it. Run `node manage.mjs status` (or `python manage.py status`). Inspect `~/.gemini/antigravity/sidecar_data/antigravity-pulse/panel/logs/sidecar.log` and `data/integration-state.json`.
Why is TPS missing in a new conversation? There are no request metrics yet. TPS is hidden instead of showing the previous chat's speed. It appears after a model response finishes.
Why do Gemini and Claude/GPT have different quotas? The service returns independent quota groups. The default follows the selected model; you can inspect another group from the context/quota card menu.
What happens after an Antigravity update? App updates cannot overwrite the runtime adapter in the user plugin directory. It rediscovers ports, credentials and the renderer automatically. See [robustness analysis](docs/ROBUSTNESS.md).
## Development and releases ```powershell npm run typecheck npm run build npm test npm run test:lifecycle npm run package ``` All TypeScript sources live under `src/` (`contracts`, `shared`, `platform`, `telemetry`, `ui`, `lifecycle`) and compile via `tools/build.mjs` (`esbuild`) into zero-dependency runtime bundles across `sidecars/panel/`, `compat/`, `ide/`, `cli/`, and `manage.mjs`. Release ZIP and VSIX archives with `.sha256` checksums are generated in `dist/`. [Development guide →](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md) · [Changelog →](CHANGELOG.md) ## License & Manual App updates Source is available under [MIT](LICENSE). Open **context details → bottom-right ⋯ → Check for updates** to run the verified App-only updater (see [docs/UPDATES.md](docs/UPDATES.md)).

Run these commands from the project directory (`node manage.mjs ` or `python manage.py `; add `--instance (all|pro|vertex)` to target a specific local instance): | Action | Command | What happens | | --- | --- | --- | | Install or update | `node manage.mjs install` | Copy runtime adapter; preserve other settings and saved statistics | | Disable | `node manage.mjs disable` | Disable the plugin and hide the strip on its next poll | | Enable | `node manage.mjs enable` | Start the plugin and show the strip again | | Inspect | `node manage.mjs status` | Check installation, enabled state, and runtime attachment health | | Uninstall | `node manage.mjs uninstall` | Remove this plugin; retain saved statistics and verified legacy backups | First installation, plugin code updates, and uninstall require a full app restart. Enable and disable do not require reinstalling. `./uninstall.ps1` / `sh uninstall.sh` runs the uninstall command. `node manage.mjs install --panel-only` disables inline attachment and installs only the sidecar panel. The internal plugin ID remains `antigravity-pulse` for compatibility with earlier installations; the public project name is **Antigrative Dashboard**. ## How the numbers work | Metric | Definition | | --- | --- | | Context window | Latest request-start `estimatedTokensUsed` / `maxContextTokens`; unknown capacity stays unavailable | | Cache hit | Cached-read tokens divided by uncached input + cache reads + cache writes; token-weighted across requests | | Token total | Normalized total input plus output tokens, including thinking output; task total includes delegated subagents | | Session TPS | Sum of eligible output tokens from valid requests divided by their total streaming duration | | Last-request TPS | Settled output tokens divided by streaming duration for the latest completed request; live turns show `Generating…` | | TTFT | Average time to first token; excluded from response streaming TPS | | Model time | TTFT plus streaming duration across requests | | Tool time | Union of tool execution intervals; overlapping time counted once | | Five-hour / weekly remaining | Account-provided `remainingFraction`; not a currency balance | | Reset countdown | Account-provided `resetTime` minus the current time | Request metrics update on a ~2.2s poll, quotas refresh every 60s, and countdowns tick every second. Antigravity normalizes `inputTokens` to uncached input even for Gemini; cache writes are not hits. ### Timing quality Very high TPS can occur when output arrives in a batch or when a brief tool call flushes after a long TTFT. The plugin checks timing quality before adding a request to session TPS; it never caps speed or invents a longer duration: - **Excluded from TPS:** invalid/split token scopes (`token-scope`), conflicting duplicate request records, multiple differing attempt usages without matching timing, zero-token samples, and buffered tool-calling windows (`short-tool-window`: stream `< 5s`, `TTFT >= 1s`, and `TTFT / duration >= 12`). - **Same-model outlier check:** with at least two otherwise eligible samples lasting `>= 1s` from the same model, provider, and raw token basis, a short sample (`< 1s`) above `max(2.5 × median, median + 6 × MAD)` is quarantined. - **Streamed thinking & active turns:** sustained multi-block thinking streams (`duration >= 15s` or `duration >= max(2s, 2 × ttft)`) pair full `outputTokens` with `streamingDuration`. Active in-flight turns display `Generating…` while anchoring `Last request` to settled requests so brief tool windows do not cause false error flicker. See [timing policy and limitations](docs/TPS.md). ## Saved conversation statistics & long conversations Context occupancy uses the current request's host-reported window (see [context limits and sources](docs/CONTEXT_LIMITS.md)). The strip did not appear after installation. Fully quit the main app process and reopen it. Run `node manage.mjs status` (or `python manage.py status`). Inspect `~/.gemini/antigravity/sidecar_data/antigravity-pulse/panel/logs/sidecar.log` and `data/integration-state.json`.
Why is TPS missing in a new conversation? There are no request metrics yet. TPS is hidden instead of showing the previous chat's speed. It appears after a model response finishes.
Why do Gemini and Claude/GPT have different quotas? The service returns independent quota groups. The default follows the selected model; you can inspect another group from the context/quota card menu.
What happens after an Antigravity update? App updates cannot overwrite the runtime adapter in the user plugin directory. It rediscovers ports, credentials and the renderer automatically. See [robustness analysis](docs/ROBUSTNESS.md).
